_note: Broad industrial sectors used for the 'Sector' field and the Sectoral Distribution chart. Assignment is by HS chapter, with the heading-level exceptions listed in 'heading_overrides' (a heading override wins over its chapter).

sectors.name: Agriculture & Allied
sectors.description: Live animals, fish, plants, vegetables, fruit, coffee, tea, spices, cereals, oilseeds, lac and tobacco.

sectors.name: Food Processing
sectors.description: Meat, dairy, milling, edible oils, sugar, confectionery, bakery, prepared foods, beverages and feed.

sectors.name: Minerals & Mining
sectors.description: Salt, stone, cement, ores, slag and ash.

sectors.name: Petroleum, Coal & Energy
sectors.description: Coal, crude oil, petroleum products, gas and electrical energy.

sectors.name: Chemicals & Petrochemicals
sectors.description: Inorganic and organic chemicals, dyes, paints, cosmetics, soaps, adhesives, explosives and specialty chemicals.

sectors.name: Pharmaceuticals
sectors.description: Medicaments, vaccines, APIs (vitamins, hormones, alkaloids, antibiotics) and dressings.

sectors.name: Fertilizers
sectors.description: Nitrogenous, phosphatic, potassic and mixed fertilizers.

sectors.name: Plastics & Polymers
sectors.description: Polymers in primary forms and plastic articles.

sectors.name: Rubber & Tyres
sectors.description: Natural and synthetic rubber, tyres, tubes and rubber articles.

sectors.name: Leather & Footwear
sectors.description: Hides, leather, saddlery, handbags, furskins and footwear.

sectors.name: Wood, Paper & Printing
sectors.description: Wood and articles, cork, basketware, pulp, paper, paperboard and printed matter.

sectors.name: Textiles & Apparel
sectors.description: Silk, wool, cotton, jute, man-made fibres, yarns, fabrics, technical textiles, apparel and made-ups.

sectors.name: Building Materials, Ceramics & Glass
sectors.description: Articles of stone, plaster, cement, asbestos, ceramics and glass.

sectors.name: Gems & Jewellery
sectors.description: Pearls, precious stones, precious metals, jewellery and coin.

sectors.name: Iron & Steel
sectors.description: Iron and steel and articles of iron or steel.

sectors.name: Non-Ferrous Metals
sectors.description: Copper, nickel, aluminium, lead, zinc, tin and other base metals.

sectors.name: Engineering Goods & Machinery
sectors.description: Tools, cutlery, base-metal articles, machinery, boilers and mechanical appliances.

sectors.name: Electronics & Electrical
sectors.description: Electrical machinery, telecom equipment, consumer electronics, semiconductors and components.

sectors.name: Automobiles & Auto Components
sectors.description: Tractors, cars, commercial vehicles, two-wheelers, bicycles and their parts.

sectors.name: Rail, Aerospace & Shipbuilding
sectors.description: Railway rolling stock, aircraft, spacecraft, drones, ships and boats.

sectors.name: Medical & Precision Instruments
sectors.description: Optical, measuring, medical and surgical instruments, clocks and musical instruments.

sectors.name: Arms & Defence
sectors.description: Arms, ammunition and military vehicles.

sectors.name: Furniture, Toys & Misc. Manufactures
sectors.description: Headgear, umbrellas, furniture, lighting, toys, sports goods and miscellaneous manufactures.

sectors.name: Art & Antiques
sectors.description: Works of art, collectors' pieces and antiques.

sectors.name: Special Classification
sectors.description: Project imports, personal baggage and other special national classifications.
